title: chat-server: Space/get and backend permission lookups key on principal_id, owner member entry is accountId
description: Found while fixing JMAP-yt1w.29. After .29 the owner's SpaceMember/ChatMember entry is the accountId (draft cefc217 §Terminology), but membership/permission resolution still matches members[].id against B::principal_id(caller): space.rs handle_space_get (non_member_non_previewable / project_space_for_caller), memory.rs caller_effective_permissions / caller_highest_position in validate_space_patch_ops and apply_space_metadata_patch_impl, may_set_pinned_messages_with_caller_id, may_set_space_ban_with_caller_id. With principal_id != accountId (e.g. IdentityBackend principal user-alice, account a1) the owner, after Space/join, gets the non-member restricted view of its own Space (no members) and none of its roles' permissions apply. Repro: tests/identity_writes.rs space_join_with_identity_writes_account_id_into_member_id originally read the Space back as the joining principal and got no members array. Needs a decision: owner membership/permission keyed on accountId (which collapses the IdentityBackend multi-principal-in-one-account test model used across tests/) or document principal_id == accountId for chat accounts.
notes:
2026-10-18: same cefc217 Terminology rule as .29: membership/permission resolution for the caller must match the owner's member entry (accountId); fix in the 405z wave before push.
2026-10-18 fix (uncommitted): caller membership/permission resolution now keys on the accountId when identity is wired (principal_id Some); principal_id None keeps single-user full access. Sites: space.rs handle_space_get (non_member_non_previewable / project_space_for_caller), memory.rs validate_space_patch_ops, apply_space_metadata_patch_impl, may_set_pinned_messages_with_caller_id (group admin + channel pin), may_set_space_ban_with_caller_id. ChatBackend docs (apply_space_metadata_patch, may_set_custom_emoji) now state the accountId lookup contract. Existing IdentityBackend tests whose fixtures keyed the caller's own member entry by principal were rekeyed to ACCOUNT_ID per draft cefc217 Terminology; read-back-after-owner-leaves helpers read storage in single-user mode. Gates green. Follow-up: JMAP-yt1w.33.
